name: Six Senses Vana
positioning: A 21-acre wellness retreat in Dehradun, named after its forest, blending Ayurveda, Yoga, Tibetan Medicine and Natural Healing Therapies
best_for: Travelers seeking a structured wellness retreat with daily treatments
Guests interested in Ayurveda, Yoga and Tibetan Medicine

facts.text: Six Senses Vana is a wellness retreat in Dehradun, India.
The retreat is on Mussoorie Road, Uttarakhand.
Six Senses Vana is a 21-acre retreat.
The retreat is named after the forest it sits in.
Natural Healing Therapies include reflexology, physiotherapy, acupuncture and Raag therapy.
The team includes Ayurvedic doctors, Yoga teachers, Tibetan healers, fitness experts, acupuncturists and reflexologists.
Optional extras include Subtle Energies treatments, acupuncture, reflexology and realignment.
Guests can tailor their itinerary with a program based on their wellness intention, with diagnostics and expert guidance.
Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served at Salana.
Ingredients are locally sourced, seasonal, fresh and organic.

highlights.text: Wellness combines Ayurveda, Yoga, Tibetan Medicine and Natural Healing Therapies.
Guests can access alumni of the Men-Tsee-Khang for Tibetan Medicine diagnostics and treatment.
Every stay includes full-board accommodation with guided nutrition, daily retreat activities, wellness consultation and screening, and daily treatments.
The retreat is named after the forest it sits in.

considerations.text: Stays are structured wellness retreats with full board and a daily program, rather than a conventional resort stay.
WhataHotel notes the wellness-focused environment may not suit leisure-seeking guests.
